description: Capability for every Arlesh window. Every window is the same tab strip, built from one config template under a label minted at runtime (`main`, `board-<uuid>`), so the grant is by wildcard: a window listed by name would leave every torn-off window without the event bus, and a torn-off window that cannot listen never receives a tab or a board change. `core:window:allow-close` is what lets closing a window's last tab close the window; `core:default` grants only the window getters.
